card.name: Hypersensitivity contraindication wording
card.fires_on: The word 'to' right after 'hypersensitivity' (or a comma or period after an allergy-related drug class) in contraindication statements. The next word is the drug or ingredient the patient is allergic to.

modes.label: 'to' after hypersensitivity
modes.description: The word 'to' that follows 'hypersensitivity' in a contraindication, just before the named drug.
modes.example: VYVGART is contraindicated in patients with a history of serious hypersensitivity<< to>> efgartigimod alfa

modes.label: Punctuation after allergy class
modes.description: A comma or period closing a list or clause about sulfonamide or ester-type allergy and cross-sensitivity.
modes.example: Patients allergic to para-aminobenzoic acid derivatives (procaine, tetracaine, benzocaine, etc<<.)>> have not shown cross-sensitivity to lid
